items.title: Corpay (CPAY) Could Be 9% Undervalued Following Q3 Beat And Higher Guidance
items.summary: Corpay (CPAY) is back in focus after reporting third quarter revenue of US$1.38b and net income of US$378.42m. The company also raised its full-year revenue and earnings guidance for 2026. The strong third quarter has landed on a stock that already had momentum, with a 39.26% year to date share price return and a 59.96% total shareholder return over the past year. items.title: Corpay’s (NYSE:CPAY) Q3 2026 sales beat estimates
items.summary: Business payments company Corpay (NYSE:CPAY) reported Q3 2026 results exceeding the market’s revenue expectations, with revenue up 17.9% year on year to $1.38 billion. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $5.35 billion at the midpoint came in 0.6% above analysts’ consensus estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $7.54 per share was 4.7% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
